name: harness link: a part with a harness route — connectors X1, M1, X2 along the route and a clip, no wires yet
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const H = () => m.project.parts.find((p) => p.id === window.__hlPart).features.find((f) => f.type === 'route' && f.kind === 'harness'); const res = () => { const p = m.project.parts.find((x) => x.id === window.__hlPart); return m.actions.buildPart(p).result.results.get(H().id); }; await m.actions.ensureKernel(); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part'); await wait(400); await m.run('harnessRoute'); await wait(600); await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await wait(400); window.__hlPart = m.active().id; m.actions.change('op.edit', (pr) => { const f = pr.parts.find((x) => x.id === window.__hlPart).features.find((x) => x.type === 'route' && x.kind === 'harness'); f.points = [[0, 0, 20], [150, 0, 20], [300, 0, 20]]; f.branches = []; f.bendRadius = 20; f.endAllowance = 0; f.connectors = [{ name: 'X1', at: [0, 0, 20], pins: 4, type: 'rect25' }, { name: 'M1', at: [150, 0, 20], pins: 2, type: 'rect25' }, { name: 'X2', at: [300, 0, 20], pins: 4, type: 'rect25' }]; f.clips = [{ name: 'C1', at: [75, 0, 20], type: 'pClip' }]; f.wires = []; }); await wait(500); const r = res(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r?.ok, wires: H().wires.length, conns: H().connectors.length }); })()

name: harness link: the schematic — X1, X2, M1 and a lamp; the PM compares it with the harness: three wires missing, a splice-free net, one unplaced lamp net ignored
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const H = () => m.project.parts.find((p) => p.id === window.__hlPart).features.find((f) => f.type === 'route' && f.kind === 'harness'); const res = () => { const p = m.project.parts.find((x) => x.id === window.__hlPart); return m.actions.buildPart(p).result.results.get(H().id); }; await m.run('schematic'); await wait(400); const S = m.schematic; const x1 = S.placeSymbol('connector', 40, 60); const x2 = S.placeSymbol('connector', 160, 60); const m1 = S.placeSymbol('motor', 100, 130); const p1 = S.placeSymbol('lamp', 100, 170); const sc = () => S.schematic(); const tag = (id) => sc().symbols.find((s) => s.id === id).tag; const w1 = S.addWire({ sym: x1, pin: '1' }, { sym: x2, pin: '1' }); const w2 = S.addWire({ sym: x1, pin: '2' }, { sym: m1, pin: 'U' }); const w3 = S.addWire({ sym: x2, pin: '4' }, { sym: m1, pin: 'V' }); S.addWire({ sym: x1, pin: '3' }, { sym: p1, pin: 'X1' }); m.actions.change('op.edit', () => { const s = sc(); Object.assign(s.wires.find((w) => w.id === w1), { color: 'RD', gauge: '1,5 mm²', number: '101' }); Object.assign(s.wires.find((w) => w.id === w3), { color: 'blue', gauge: 'AWG 18' }); }); window.__hlW = { w1, w2, w3 }; await wait(300); m.run('schematic'); await wait(200); m.run('schematic'); await wait(400); const st = q('[data-sch-sync]'); const c = S.compare(); return JSON.stringify({ tags: [tag(x1), tag(x2), tag(m1)].join(','), harnesses: S.harnesses().length, sync: st?.dataset.schSync, missing: c.missing.length, extra: c.extra.length, listed: document.querySelectorAll('.sch-h-list li').length >= 3, buttons: Boolean(q('[data-pm="sch.toHarness"]')) && Boolean(q('[data-pm="sch.lengths"]')) }); })()

name: harness link: Send to harness — the route gets the three wires with the schematic colours and sizes, rebuilds, and the status says in sync
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const H = () => m.project.parts.find((p) => p.id === window.__hlPart).features.find((f) => f.type === 'route' && f.kind === 'harness'); const res = () => { const p = m.project.parts.find((x) => x.id === window.__hlPart); return m.actions.buildPart(p).result.results.get(H().id); }; q('[data-pm="sch.toHarness"]').click(); await wait(700); const ws = H().wires.map((w) => `${w.name}:${w.from}${w.fromPin}-${w.to}${w.toPin}:${w.color}:${w.gauge}`).sort(); const r = res(); return JSON.stringify({ ws, ok: r?.ok, bom: r?.route?.bom?.wires?.length, sync: q('[data-sch-sync]')?.dataset.schSync }); })()

name: harness link: Lengths from harness — the routed lengths land on the schematic wires, the wire PM and the from–to CSV; one undo removes them
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const H = () => m.project.parts.find((p) => p.id === window.__hlPart).features.find((f) => f.type === 'route' && f.kind === 'harness'); const res = () => { const p = m.project.parts.find((x) => x.id === window.__hlPart); return m.actions.buildPart(p).result.results.get(H().id); }; q('[data-pm="sch.lengths"]').click(); await wait(500); const s = m.schematic.schematic(); const L = (id) => s.wires.find((w) => w.id === id)?.length; const lens = [L(window.__hlW.w1), L(window.__hlW.w2), L(window.__hlW.w3)]; m.schematic.select(window.__hlW.w1); await wait(300); const shown = q('[data-sch-length]')?.dataset.schLength; let saved = null; window.showSaveFilePicker = async (o) => ({ name: o?.suggestedName ?? 'x.csv', createWritable: async () => ({ write: async (b) => { saved = typeof b === 'string' ? b : await b.text(); }, close: async () => {} }) }); await m.schematic.exportFromTo(); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !saved; i++) await wait(100); const csvLen = /^101,X1:1,X2:1,.*,300$/m.test(saved ?? ''); await m.actions.undo(); await wait(400); const after = m.schematic.schematic().wires.filter((w) => w.length != null).length; return JSON.stringify({ lens, shown, csvLen, after }); })()

name: harness link: a colour changed in the schematic shows as a difference; the harness route takes it with Wires from schematic, keeping the clip it was told to pass
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const H = () => m.project.parts.find((p) => p.id === window.__hlPart).features.find((f) => f.type === 'route' && f.kind === 'harness'); const res = () => { const p = m.project.parts.find((x) => x.id === window.__hlPart); return m.actions.buildPart(p).result.results.get(H().id); }; m.actions.change('op.edit', () => { const s = m.schematic.schematic(); s.wires.find((w) => w.id === window.__hlW.w1).color = 'GN'; }); m.actions.change('op.edit', (pr) => { const f = pr.parts.find((x) => x.id === window.__hlPart).features.find((x) => x.type === 'route' && x.kind === 'harness'); f.wires.find((w) => w.name === '101').via = ['C1']; }); await wait(300); m.run('schematic'); await wait(200); m.run('schematic'); await wait(300); const changed = m.schematic.compare().changed.map((x) => `${x.field}:${x.schematic}:${x.harness}`); const pmShows = /GN/.test(q('.sch-h-list')?.textContent ?? ''); m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); await m.actions.switchDocument({ kind: 'part', id: window.__hlPart }); await wait(400); m.actions.editFeature(H().id); await wait(600); const btn = q('[data-pm="routeEdit:fromSchematic"]'); btn?.click(); await wait(500); await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await wait(500); const w = H().wires.find((x) => x.name === '101'); const r = res(); return JSON.stringify({ changed, pmShows, button: Boolean(btn), colour: w?.color, via: w?.via, ok: r?.ok, inSync: m.schematic.compare === undefined ? null : (await (async () => { m.run('schematic'); await wait(300); const v = m.schematic.compare().inSync; m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); return v; })()) }); })()
